problem: Align pretrained2Dvision-language processing with spatially precise3Drobot manipulation while reducing target demonstration requirements.
contribution: BridgeVLA pretrains language-conditioned2Dheatmap grounding, then predicts heatmaps on three orthographic renders of a3Dscene and converts them into keyframe actions.
algorithm: Use PaliGemma features with learned convex upsampling to output detection heatmaps. Reconstruct a calibrated RGBD point cloud, render top/front/right views, predict view heatmaps and back-project to score3Dworkspace grid points. Predict rotation, gripper and collision flags with additional heads.
observations: One or more calibrated RGBD images and language; although the VLM backbone consumes rendered RGB, metric3Dgeometry/depth remains required upstream. No raw proprioception is passed into its VLM forward path.
actions: Next-keyframe6DOFend-effector pose, gripper bit and collision flag consumed by a motion planner. A learned collision flag is an instruction to the planner, not proof that a motion is safe.
embodiment_and_data: Detection-grounding pretraining and robot demonstrations; simulation RLBench/COLOSSEUM/GemBench and real tasks. Basic real comparison uses10demonstrations/task except SpatialVLA50; few-shot3demo experiments are a separate setting.
experiments: Basic real table13tasks×10trials/method, manually aligned scene snapshots; simulation includes novel long-horizon GemBenchL4. Source separates visual disturbance, instruction-combination and category tests.
baselines: SpatialVLA, pi0, separate single-task ACT, RVT-2 and3Dsimulation methods. Input/depth access, demonstration quantities and language conditioning differ across some comparisons.

quantitative_result.value: Basic real Table4 BridgeVLA96.9% from printed126/130raw task successes, versusRVT-290%; this uses10demos/task. GemBench overall50.0% includesL4long-horizon0.0%, while3D-LOTUS++achieves17.4%L4. Do not equate the separate abstract3demo96.8%claim with this basic protocol.
quantitative_result.location: PDF p10 Table4 and p9 Table3

limitations: Long-horizon composition remains weak despite high overall averages. Calibrated depth, keyframe extraction and a functioning robot-specific planner are assumptions. VLM-only RGB processing does not make the full pipeline monocular or calibration-free.
code_and_license: Primary architecture/results read; exact executable code/base-model/detection-data licenses were not independently audited and no BridgeVLA execution is claimed.
hardware_adaptation: An informative3Dtarget-generation baseline after metric depth/calibration is available. Keep heatmaps, geometric candidates, planner validity and actual physical outcomes separate; one overview RGB stream alone does not satisfy the source contract.
